about: Test cases for the action binding extension 0.1.0. Schema cases apply a patch to a base attachment (A0: an approved and executed payment; A1: a rejected one) or to base_report (an empty patch tests the base itself), so each negative case differs from a valid instance by the one thing it tests; C cases check the fixture records against the core decision-record schema in standard/v5.0. Binding cases run the reference check on one attachment, with its decision record or without it (record null); every dimension is expected verified, and execution_state attempted, unless the case's expected says otherwise. Pairing cases read base_report with the attachments it covers, which JSON Schema cannot do. Patch operations: set, remove, copy (to), insert (into a list), move (to). Specifications S0 to S4 and records R0 and R1 are synthetic; their bytes are the UTF-8 (here ASCII) encoding of each text, and the digests below also serve as simple vectors. S1, S2 and S3 change only the amount, the target and the destination of S0; S5 is S0 without its policy_version.
